name: NeuroLearn Adaptive STEM
idea_description: An adaptive online learning engine using AI cognitive models to personalize math and physics problem sets for high school students.
target_audience: AP Physics and Calculus students, high school STEM teachers, homeschooling parents
constraints: FERPA student data compliance, low latency on dynamic assessments

name: FleetZero Carbon Optimizer
idea_description: SaaS route optimization software for regional trucking fleets to reduce diesel consumption and calculate verifiable Scope 1 carbon tax credits.
target_audience: Logistics managers with 20 to 150 commercial vehicle fleets
technical_preferences: Microservices or modular monolith, geospatial queries
constraints: EU CSRD carbon accounting regulatory guidelines, offline telematics sync

name: PromptVibe Audio Kits
idea_description: Curated royalty-free sound effects and procedural ambient audio generator for independent YouTube and podcast producers.
target_audience: Solo video editors, game streamers, podcast producers
constraints: Must operate profitably on under $20/month hosting

name: PulseCardio Remote Telehealth
idea_description: Secure remote telemetry portal for private cardiology practices monitoring post-operative pacemaker and Holter monitor data.
target_audience: Independent cardiology clinics and post-acute cardiac patients
constraints: HIPAA compliance, BAA required with all third-party providers, audit logging

name: VendorMatch Procurement Agent
idea_description: Automated RFP and supplier negotiation assistant that extracts pricing matrices from PDF quote requests and flags contractual risks.
target_audience: Mid-market procurement leads and corporate purchasing controllers
technical_preferences: Python, vector embedding search, secure PDF generation
constraints: SOC2 compliance readiness, multi-tenant data isolation
